result:
I could not derive this from first principles in the time available, so the answer below is a recollection of the literature, not a verified result. I believe this question comes from work by Naor and Sheffield on absolutely minimal Lipschitz extensions on finite metric spaces. My recollection is that existence holds for small spaces and that a counterexample first appears at 7 points, but I am not certain of the exact threshold.

ANSWER: 7
